Hey! Ex-redditor here. You know the rest.

I was wondering if, perhaps, it could be an (informal) policy for moderators to discuss subverse matters in publicly viewable threads. This would mean that though only moderators could comment in these threads, your average voater could still view the discussion and maybe even voat on the replies. Though it wouldn't be a hard-and-fast rule, it might be a good idea to expect moderator transparency from the start. Every policy change would be backed up by publicly viewable discussion and reasoning.

This way, if something strange up and hits a subverse out of the blue, users feel more justified in feeling concerned because there wasn't any public discourse about it.

Of course, I know we can't stop mods from communicating in private, but if we make transparency a cultural norm here at voat, I feel like we'll be more empowered as users.

Thoughts?
